Title: Unsafe HTML and Scheme Escape Case
Author: Jane Doe <jane@example.com>
Posted: 2026-04-01
Revision: 1
News-Item-Format: 2.0

Ignore raw tags like <script>alert(1)</script> and <img src=x onerror=alert(1)>.
Do not link javascript:alert(1) or data:text/html,<script>1</script>.
Email Jane at jane@example.com and check <https://example.com/safe(v1)>.

  <script>do-not-render()</script>
  https://example.com/inside-code-block
